LA-2026-HB1223.aiSummary: The law creates a statewide system to speed up early clinical trials in Louisiana and improve patient access to study treatments. It requires hospitals, health care providers, schools, and other research groups that run covered clinical trials in the state to join the system and sign a participation agreement.
